# Helvety Store

> Official Helvety Store. Products and services engineered and designed in Switzerland.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://helvety.com/store): Browse the Helvety product catalog
- [Products](https://helvety.com/store/products): Full listing of all available Helvety products and services
- [SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer): SharePoint Online Explorer - paid subscription (see product page for current pricing and terms)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-pdf): PDF toolkit currently available at no cost (see product page for current terms)
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-tasks): E2E encrypted task management (see product page for current pricing and availability)
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-contacts): E2E encrypted contact management (see product page for current pricing and availability)

## Helvety Ecosystem
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com): Main Helvety website with company information and legal pages
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): PDF toolkit currently available at no cost
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth): Centralized authentication for all Helvety apps
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Contact management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Task management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields

## Optional
- [GitHub](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Public monorepo for all Helvety applications (source-visible, not open source)
